study: Registered public-triangle predictive sensitivity and synthetic calibration
primary_scoring: Both 80% and 95% central coverage plus interval scores/widths, normalized by latest observed cumulative amounts. Report all methods and scenarios; do not select a winner or retune.
public_split: For n origins, valuations m=max(4,n-4)..n-1; fit only i+j<m; predict i=2..m-1 next observed cumulative amounts. Exclude new origin and age with fewer than two historical pairs. RAA 22 old inspected predictions reproduced, never called new holdout.
public_aggregate: Sum only eligible next-diagonal cumulative cells. Normal/lognormal moment approximations of known-subset sums; no claim of observed final reserve calibration.
public_distribution: Mack normal and lognormal moment approximations for aggregate positive reserve mean; next-diagonal lognormal applies to positive cumulative amounts. Normal endpoints and negative simulated reserves retained.
shared_factor_simulation: Independent positive age factor draws f* with E=f and Var=sigma2/sum(C); same f* shared across origins at that age. Positive conditional cumulative gamma/lognormal transitions with E=f*C, Var=sigma2*C. sigma2 fixed, no resampling or dispersion re-estimation. Explicit heuristic; neither bootstrap nor posterior; compare law-of-total-variance decomposition and fixed-factor process-only draws.
numerical_gamma_rule: Zero cumulative gamma underflows retained, subsequent 0/0-moment transitions absorbing; no positive floor/redraw/draw deletion. Report final zero-origin counts. This is finite-precision approximation.
tail_rule: Deterministic multiplier on all final-age ultimate values, including oldest origin; standard error multiplied by factor with no extra tail variability. Sensitivity only; no chosen best factor.
calendar_diagnostic: Leverage-adjusted Mack residuals by calendar and age; descriptive counts/means/std, no unsupported independence test or p-value.

calibration_design.shock: Mean factor multiplied 1.10 at first unobserved calendar (i+k+1=8) only; variance sigma2*C unchanged, later factors stable.
calibration_design.shared_calendar: rho=.35 within same-calendar normal innovations before lognormal transform; each cell retains prescribed conditional mean/variance while origin independence is violated.
calibration_design.truth: Realized full-horizon future cumulative ultimate sum minus latest observed sum; not mean reserve and not simulated public-triangle truth.
calibration_design.seeds: DGP SeedSequence [20261011,scenario_index,replicate,0]; forecasts [20261011,scenario_index,replicate,1 or 2]. Gamma DGP per-cell independent [DGPseed,i,k,901]. Seed IDs fixed, every case retained.
calibration_design.failure_rule: Retain failed methods in case table and coverage denominator; scores exclude failed rows only with count and denominator explicit. Structural/nonfinite pipeline failure blocks publication; no silent skipped source or alternative-source substitution.

registration_scope: Public pre-extension protocol before four new CSV collections and primary study execution. Original RAA data/predictions and public documentation examples (including some ABC summaries) already inspected. Public triangles are retrospective convenience benchmarks, not unseen prospective studies.

alternatives.odp_residual_bootstrap: Established two-stage incremental approach considered; differs from Mack cumulative moment model and requires explicit signed/negative-increment handling. Not silently substituted or claimed replicated.
alternatives.published_mack_bootstrap: Correct parametric-family and estimation-error assumptions cannot be inferred from 55 RAA cells; recent consistency paper distinguishes process and estimation risk. This simpler heuristic is deliberately named and calibrated as such.
alternatives.cornish_fisher: Official package quantiles additionally estimate skewness. Not replicated in this two-moment comparison; higher-moment/tail-estimation comparison remains open.
alternatives.bayesian_calendar_models: Potential stronger explicit dependence model; omitted to keep comparison finite and avoid pretending validated priors/client calibration; no assertion globally optimal.

interpretation: No nominal-coverage, regulator-capital, client valuation, IAS19/ASC715, new insurer generalization, original-vintage or independent review claim. AI-assisted research; candidate mastery deferred.
